case: P06/E03 DeepSeek × Chat Completions history: reasoning_content replay with tool calls and results, other APIs' turns, images
source: Synthetic offline fixture. Chunk shapes follow DeepSeek's streamed Chat Completions (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion/ and the thinking mode guide https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/, read 2026-10-02: reasoning_content deltas, usage with prompt_cache_hit_tokens/prompt_cache_miss_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, finish_reason stop/length/content_filter/tool_calls/insufficient_system_resource, data: [DONE]) as consumed by pi-ai 0.87.1 (commit 898ab804050730e9dcefb4443875d5a932aa6a32) packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.ts through openai-node 6.40.0. Expected requests follow pi's buildParams and convertMessages for DeepSeek's detected compat (no store, no developer role, max_tokens, thinkingFormat deepseek, reasoning_content on assistant messages); the models are pi's deepseek.json openai-completions entries (ADR-0015). Error bodies follow DeepSeek's documented error codes (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/error_codes) in OpenAI's error object shape; their texts are illustrative. Costs are pi's calculateCost at the frozen prices of the model used.

scenarios.about: A same-model thinking turn with a tool call, answered by the host, with thinking still on: the reasoning goes back as reasoning_content beside the call (DeepSeek requires it in thinking mode), the result as a tool message, instructions as system.
Assistant turns without reasoning — text only, and a call made with thinking off — still carry reasoning_content, empty, as DeepSeek requires on every assistant message of a reasoning model.
A turn with reasoning and text goes back with both: the text as the content string, the reasoning as reasoning_content (joined by a newline when it streamed in two blocks); blank thinking is dropped.
The round trip's history restored without the host vouching for it: the reasoning replays as plain text in the content, reasoning_content goes out empty and the call keeps its id.
An OpenAI Chat turn (gpt-5-mini) replayed to DeepSeek: its reasoning becomes text, signatures go, the call id is kept whole (DeepSeek is not OpenAI) and reasoning_content goes out empty.

A DeepSeek Responses turn on the same account replayed to DeepSeek Chat: another API is another model for history, so its reasoning becomes text and the Responses call id 'call_ds_1|fc_ds_1' becomes 'call_ds_1_fc_ds_1' on the call and its result.
deepseek-flash takes images: the user image as an image_url data URL; a tool result's image follows the run of results in one user message.
deepseek-v4-pro takes text only: pi's placeholders replace the images and no image message follows the results.
